description: The frontier: patrols, keep sieges (attacking), keep defense, relic raids, and the outcome of a siege.

lines.text: Patrolling the frontier near {zone}. No sign of {enemyrealm} yet.
Keep an eye on the bridges. That is where they usually cross.
Rams to the gate at {keep}! Archers, clear the walls!
On my way to {keep}. Save me a spot by the ram.
{enemyrealm} at the gates of {keep}! All defenders to the walls!
Eyes on the relic. Nobody carries it home on our watch.
{keep} flies our banner! Well done, everyone.
We lost {keep}, but we know the way back. Regroup and rest.
Quiet on the road so far. Too quiet for my liking.
Anyone else watching the bridge near {zone}? I could use a second pair of eyes.
Small group of {enemyrealm} moving along the tree line in {zone}.
Heading out to check the towers in {zone}. Back soon if they let me.
If you see a shimmer in the grass, that is a stealther. Shout it out.
Nothing but wind and crows out here tonight.
I count six {enemyrealm} on the hill. Could be more behind them.
Bridge is clear. For now.
Fresh bodies by the road to the milegate. Somebody got jumped.
{enemyrealm} zerg rolling through {zone}, stay off the main road!
Doing a lap of the keeps. Guards look bored, which is a good sign.
The frontier always feels colder than it should.
Scouting ahead. If I go quiet, assume the worst.
Got ganked at the bridge. Two of them, maybe three. Careful out there.
Lone {enemyrealm} archer pinging people near the tower. Anyone close?
Thought I saw a flash of movement by the river. Probably nothing.
Patrol group forming at the portal keep. Bring potions.
Keep your back to a wall and your eyes on the road.
Nothing moves on this frontier without someone seeing it.
Are the towers in {zone} still ours? Last I heard we held them all.
Spotted a big {enemyrealm} group heading for our side. Might be a raid.
I love the frontier at dawn. Mist on the hills, nobody trying to kill me yet.
Checking the bushes for stealthers. Somebody has to.
{enemyrealm} stealther just tried to gut me on the road. Ran off when I turned.
Heard a scream from the woods. Not one of ours, I hope.
Roads are empty. Either they are asleep or they are planning something.
Out here for the realm points and the fresh air. Mostly the realm points.
Scout report: {enemyrealm} massing near the border. Numbers unknown.
One more sweep of the river and then back to the portal keep for me.
Found a dead {enemyrealm} by the bridge. Someone has been busy.
Whoever is patrolling the north road, stay sharp. Something is moving out there.
If you see a lone {enemyrealm}, it is bait. Assume a group is nearby.
Seen any stealthers tonight? I swear I keep hearing footsteps.
Frontier feels restless today. Keep your armor on.
Five {enemyrealm} heading our way along the river. Not a drill.
Anybody up for a small roam? Nothing big, just a few of us.
A tower in {zone} just went dark. Somebody check it.
Watching the bridge from the trees. Anyone who crosses, I will see.
Do not chase them over the bridge. That is how they get you.
Old Frontiers never sleep. Neither do I, apparently.
My feet hurt. The frontier is far too big to walk.
Stealther alert near {zone}. Group up, do not wander alone.
Ambush ahead by the ford. I saw them drop into the reeds.
Patrolling with {guild}. Shout if you need a hand.
Guild, I am out on patrol in {zone} if anyone wants company.
{guild} has the bridge covered for a while.
Evening all. Frontier is calm, but I am not trusting it.
{enemyrealm} scouts keep poking at our towers. Testing us, I think.
Speed would be nice right about now. Anyone got a song?
Careful near the treeline, archers love it there.
Dropped a {enemyrealm} healer near the bridge. The rest scattered.
The frontier smells like rain and old battles.
Quiet nights out here are the ones that worry me.
Scouting the enemy approach. Will report anything bigger than a handful.
Three {enemyrealm} just crossed the river and vanished. Stealthers, likely.
Stay in pairs out here. A lone traveller is an easy mark.
Hush. Something is moving behind that rock.
Long patrol tonight. Wake me if anything happens.
Quiet along Hadrian's Wall tonight. I do not trust it.
Watching the milegate at Hadrian's Wall. Shout if anything comes through.
Pennine Mountains are crawling with scouts today.
Odin's Gate is calm. Calm makes me nervous.
Watching the road past Bledmeer Faste. Nothing yet.
Snow on the passes in Jamtland. Good for tracking, bad for my toes.
Emain Macha is calm tonight and the river is still.
Keeping an eye on Dun Crauchon from the hills.
Mist over Breifine again. Perfect weather for an ambush.
Same here. Nothing moving on my side.
Swinging by to take a look.
Thanks for the warning. Staying off the road.
Watch yourself out there.
Heading your way now.
Shout if it turns into something bigger.
I saw them too. They were moving fast.
Probably a scout. They like to test us.
Good eyes. Keep watching.
Do not engage alone, wait for a few of us.
Other bridge is covered, do not worry.
Could be bait. Be careful.
Noted. I will pass it on to the others.
Stealthers everywhere tonight, it seems.
Count me in if a roaming group forms.
Copy that. Holding my position.
Sounds like a raid coming. Better warn the keeps.
My side is quiet too. Strange night.
Hug the trees and you will be fine.
Careful, the last person who said that got jumped.
Same, I keep looking over my shoulder.
Agreed. Something is brewing out there.
Go scout ahead, I will keep the bridge.
heh, that is how it always starts.
I can be there shortly if it gets ugly.
Ram is up at {keep}! Everyone on the door!
Healers, stay behind the ram and keep the hitters standing.
Archers on the walls of {keep}, mind your heads!
Outer door of {keep} is cracking. Keep pushing!
Inner door next. Do not stop now.
Who brought the ram? Please tell me somebody brought the ram.
The lord of {keep} is waiting. Let us not keep him waiting long.
Clear the guards off the gate before the ram goes in.
Their casters are on the tower roof. Focus them!
Stay out of the archers' line of fire, hug the wall.
Door at {keep} is down! Pour in!
Pull the guards out one at a time, no need to rush.
Everyone stack on the ram, we hit together.
{keep} will be ours before their next patrol comes by.
{enemyrealm} defenders are on the walls of {keep}. Lots of them.
Push the door, push the door!
Lord room is up the stairs. Tanks first, healers right behind.
Their healers are on the tower. Take them down and the rest folds.
Siege at {keep}! Anyone in the frontier, come help.
Taking {keep} for the realm. Who is with us?
They are throwing everything off the walls of {keep}. Spread out!
Stay out of the oil! Step back from the door when it starts pouring.
My arms are tired from swinging at this door.
That door is tougher than an old troll.
One more good push and the gate is ours.
Watch for a counter raid coming up behind us.
Somebody keep an eye on the road. Their relief force will come.
Marching on {keep}. Bring your best.
I can see their lord from here. He looks nervous.
Group one on the ram, group two on the walls, group three watch our backs.
Lots of {enemyrealm} archers on the battlements. Use cover.
The courtyard is a killing ground. Wait for the healers before you rush in.
They are trying to sally out of {keep}. Hold the line!
Nobody chases into the keep alone. We go in together.
Kill the guards, then the lord. In that order please.
We hold the field around {keep}. Now finish the door.
Do you hear that? The door is groaning. Not long now.
Sieges are long, slow and loud. I love every minute.
Hope you brought potions. This one will take a while.
Getting picked apart by their archers. Need casters on the wall.
{keep} has stood too long under {enemyrealm} colors.
Last time we took {keep} it took all night. Let us beat that.
Siege time! Get in here, everyone with a weapon.
They have a healer on the gatehouse keeping everyone up. Kill that one first.
Remember, the guards hit hard. Do not pull more than you can handle.
We lost the ram. Anyone carrying another?
Inside! We are inside {keep}!
Up the stairs, to the lord!
Lord fight! Everyone in the room!
Bless the healers back there, they are keeping this push alive.
{guild} is first through the gate at {keep}!
Guild, we are sieging {keep}, come join us.
If we take {keep}, {guild} could claim it.
The frontier will remember who took {keep} tonight.
Every keep we take brings us closer to Darkness Falls.
Shoulders to the ram! Heave!
Half their realm seems to be here. Good, more realm points.
A few of them keep popping over the walls to snipe us. Stay grouped.
Fighting at {keep} is getting heavy, send help.
{enemyrealm} reinforcements on the road! Turn and face them!
Breach soon. Ready your best attacks.
For {realm}! Take the walls!
The door at {keep} will not open itself, friends. Swing!
Stand close to me under the wall. Fewer arrows find us here.
Staying behind the ram. Keep within my reach and I will keep you up.
Healing from the back line. Do not run off where I cannot see you.
Nuking the defenders on the wall. Point me at their healers.
Arrows on the battlements. Anyone who peeks over the edge regrets it.
I will take the front of the ram. Stand behind my shield.
Slipping around the side of {keep} to watch for their reinforcements.
My pet is chewing on the gate guard. Good pet.
Point me at whatever comes out of that door.
Buffs going out. Stay close to the ram so I can reach you.
By Arthur's crown, that door will fall.
The knights of Albion do not stop at a door. Break it!
Odin guides our axes. Break that door!
Skal! Another keep for the North before morning!
For Lugh and Hibernia! Bring down the gate!
Hibernia remembers every wall that stood against her. This one falls tonight.
On my way to the ram.
Right behind you, keep moving.
Healing as fast as these hands allow.
Coming in from the side.
I see them, moving to engage.
Door is close, keep at it.
Watch the archers on the left.
Got it. Switching to the door.
Almost there, hold on.
Their healer is down!
Watching our backs.
inc from the road!
Stacking on the ram now.
Pushing in with you.
Agreed, one more push.
Staying out of the oil, thanks.
Wall is clear on my side.
Count me in for the lord.
Bringing three more with me.
Good call. Waiting for the healers.
Keep it up, I can hear it splintering.
Fewer of them up there now.
Following your lead.
Saw that too. Spreading out.
oom, give me a moment.
Give me a second, drinking a potion.
Ready on the ram when you are.
I have the stairs.
Let them come, we are ready.
Holding the line behind the ram.
Nice, keep them busy.
Taking out the gate guard now.
Stay together, do not split up.
Defenders to the walls of {keep}! They are coming!
Oil ready over the gate. Wait for the ram.
Hold the gate! Nobody gets through!
{enemyrealm} ram at the door of {keep}! Pour the oil!
They have a ram on the outer door. Everyone down here!
Archers, focus the ones on the ram.
Casters on the battlements, rain fire on the door.
Healers, stay inside and keep the wall alive.
Do not jump off the walls! Stay up here where they cannot reach us.
Guards are fighting at the gate. Help them!
{keep} has held before and it will hold again.
They are at the inner door! Fall back to the lord room!
Lord room! Everyone to the lord!
Call for help, {keep} is under siege!
Every hand to {keep}! We need defenders!
Big {enemyrealm} force outside {keep}. Maybe forty, maybe more.
Keep your heads down, their archers have the angle.
Back wall is under attack too. Watch both sides.
The door is holding. Barely.
We only need to hold until the relief force gets here.
Reinforcements on the way. Just hold a little longer.
If the outer door falls, we hold the inner. If the inner falls, we hold the stairs.
Do not let them pull you out of the keep. That is what they want.
Stay on the walls. Their melee cannot touch you up here.
Lots of {enemyrealm} healers in the back. Hit them first.
Somebody keep the stairs clear for the healers.
{keep} is not falling tonight. Not on my watch.
Hold fast! Their numbers are thinning.
I can see their whole army from up here.
Defending {keep} with what few we have. Any help welcome.
We are badly outnumbered at {keep}. Every sword counts.
They will tire before these walls do.
Fill the gaps on the battlements, do not leave a corner empty.
Watch for stealthers slipping in behind the defenders.
Their mages are on the hill. Stay behind the stones.
Do not open the door to chase them. Let them come to us.
Oil again, they are back on the door!
Scouts saw a ram coming toward {keep}. Get ready.
Fighting at the gate of {keep}! Need everyone!
Outer door is broken. Inner door, now!
Stand with the guards, they hit harder than you think.
This is our land. They do not get to walk in.
Watching the back gate. They try it every time.
Wall duty again. I could do this in my sleep.
Holding the gatehouse with three people and a lot of stubbornness.
Guild, {keep} needs defenders. Drop what you are doing.
{guild} is holding the walls of {keep}. Send anyone you can.
Our guild banner flies over {keep}. Defend it, {guild}!
Could use a healer on the north wall. Things are getting ugly.
They will regret marching on {keep}.
The {enemyrealm} keep throwing bodies at the door. Let them.
Not one of them has made it past the courtyard. Keep it that way.
Hold the stairs at all costs!
Defend the lord!
Stay by me on the wall, friend. Two blades hold better than one.
Up here with me, quick. The view of the ram is perfect.
I am on the wall keeping you all standing. Stay in range.
Plenty of targets below. I have arrows enough for all of them.
Raining spells on the ram crew. They are not enjoying it.
I will block the doorway. Nothing passes me.
Slipping out to see how many are behind the hill.
Buffs going out on the wall. Keep them up.
Albion does not yield. Hold the walls for Camelot!
Caer Benowyc has fallen before, but not tonight.
Hold the faste! Let them break on our walls like waves on a fjord.
Bledmeer Faste is always the first they hit. Hold it!
Hold the dun! Hibernia's walls do not fall to the likes of them.
Dun Crauchon needs defenders, they always come for it first.
On my way to the walls.
Coming down to the gate.
Holding my section.
Pouring the oil now.
At the stairs now, holding.
Moving to the lord room.
Keep calm, we can hold this.
They are running low, I can see it.
Need heals on the wall!
Got the back gate covered.
Not leaving this wall.
I see the ram. Calling it out.
Right with you. Hold the gate.
Help is coming, hang on.
Good. Make them pay for every step.
Staying up top, thanks for the tip.
Ten more coming over the hill.
Gate still holding on my end.
Watch the stealthers, they love a busy wall.
The guards are doing their part. So will I.
Got two of their casters.
Hold on, I am running back from the bridge.
Count me in. Never leaving {keep} to them.
Yes, stay inside, no heroics.
Back on the wall, sorry, had to drink.
Their relic is on the move! Every hand to the road!
Relic raid forming. This is the big one.
If we take their relic, our whole realm feels it.
Our relic is in danger at {keep}. Everyone, now!
Escort the carrier! Nobody leaves their side.
Who is carrying the relic? Stay in the middle of the group.
Intercept them before they reach their gate!
They have our relic. We are not letting it leave the frontier.
Scouts say they are marching on {keep}. That is a relic keep. Move!
Get between the carrier and their army. Buy us time.
Relic keep doors are thick. Bring everyone.
Slipping ahead to watch the roads they will use.
I have never held a relic before. I just want to see one.
The whole realm is watching this raid. No pressure.
One relic changes the whole war.
Relic carrier spotted heading for the bridge. Cut them off!
Guard the relic temple. Nobody touches the pedestal.
Form up around the relic. Shields out, healers in the middle.
Every {enemyrealm} in the frontier will come for this relic.
Do not let the carrier get picked off by archers. Watch the trees.
Relic raids are not for the faint of heart.
They are trying to carry our relic home. Over my dead body. Probably literally.
A relic in our temple and the whole realm fights a little harder.
Relic keep is under attack! Drop everything!
We got the relic out of {keep}! Now we run!
Our relics sit safe for now. Stay alert.
Long road home with this relic. Watch every bend.
Their whole realm is coming. Hurry the relic along!
Rumor says {keep} is lightly guarded. The relic is there for the taking.
Never seen so many {enemyrealm} in one place. It must be the relic.
Kill the carrier and the relic drops. Focus fire!
Relic on the ground! Somebody grab it!
If the carrier falls, the closest of us picks it up. Got it?
Do not get greedy chasing kills. The relic is all that matters.
Guild, relic raid tonight. Everyone to the frontier please.
{guild} is guarding the relic carrier. Stay close to us.
Keep moving! Standing still with a relic is asking for trouble.
They will come at the carrier from every side. Stay tight.
Stay at my shoulder, friend. If the carrier falls, we cover the relic.
Merlin's Staff stays in Albion. Defend Castle Myrddin!
The Scabbard of Excalibur belongs in Castle Excalibur. Guard it with your lives.
Thor's Hammer is the pride of Midgard. Nobody takes it from us.
Grallarhorn Faste must not fall. Hold for Midgard!
The Cauldron of Dagda belongs in Hibernia. Hold Dun Dagda!
Dun Lamfhota needs every blade Hibernia has.
On the road now, heading to intercept.
Right beside the carrier.
Watching the trees for archers.
I will hold the bridge for the relic.
Coming with everyone I can find.
Stay tight, they are close.
Nothing gets past us.
Covering the rear.
Running as fast as these legs allow.
For the relic and the realm!
Shields up, they are inbound.
I can see the carrier, moving to cover.
Already on my way to {keep}.
Watch the flanks, not just the front.
Keep calm and keep walking.
Ready for whatever comes.
They will have to go through me first.
{keep} is ours! Well fought, all!
The lord falls! {keep} belongs to {realm}!
That was a fine siege. My arms will hurt tomorrow.
Another keep for {realm}. One step closer to Darkness Falls.
The {enemyrealm} ran back home. Let them tell the tale.
Our banner flies over {keep} again. Good feeling.
We held! {keep} still stands!
They broke on our walls. Well defended, everyone.
That was a good fight. Realm points for everyone.
Look at them run! Back to their own lands with them.
Thank the healers. They won this one.
Not a bad night's work.
gratz everyone on {keep}!
I will be telling this story at the tavern for a month.
Clean siege, barely a scratch. Well led.
Hard won, but won. Rest up.
Think they will come back here soon? Not after that.
Stay close for a while, they may try to take it back.
{keep} is in good hands now.
Proud to fight beside you lot.
The frontier is a little more {realm} tonight.
Victory for {realm}! Raise a cup when you get home.
Did you see their faces when the door went down?
That lord fought hard. Not hard enough.
Held the walls, held the gate, held the day.
Every hour we hold {keep} is a win.
Guild, {keep} is ours! {guild} was first through the door!
Well done, {guild}. That one goes in the guild records.
{keep} taken, and only a few of us dead. Not bad.
Victory! Now where did I drop my shield?
Nobody died on my watch. Well, almost nobody.
My quiver is empty and my heart is full.
Shield dented, armor scraped, keep taken. Worth it.
Out of power and grinning. Good siege.
For Albion and for Camelot! Well fought!
Skal! A victory worthy of the halls of Valhalla!
Hibernia stands proud tonight. Well fought, friends.
Well fought, all of you!
Gratz all, great work.
Thanks for leading us in.
Good work, everyone.
Could not have done it without the healers.
That was fun. Again soon?
Agreed, a fine fight.
Hard fought and well earned.
My armor needs mending but I am smiling.
Proud of this group.
They will be back, so stay sharp.
Best siege in weeks.
I lost count of my kills. Great fun.
Cheers to that.
Glad to be part of it.
{keep} has fallen. Fall back and regroup.
They took it. We will take it back.
Too many of them. Nothing more we could do.
Lost {keep} to the {enemyrealm}. It stings.
We fought well. They just had more.
Fall back to the next keep and gather there.
Their healers outlasted ours. Lesson learned.
Siege broken. Everyone back to the portal keep.
Well, that did not go to plan.
We will be back for {keep}. Count on it.
Do not rush back in one at a time. Gather first.
They held the walls better than we expected.
Ran out of time and ran out of healers.
I hate watching their banner go up over {keep}.
Released and walking back. Long walk.
Lucky for them. Next time we will be ready.
Lick your wounds. We go again when we are ready.
{keep} is lost, but the war is not.
Every keep changes hands sooner or later. Ours will come back.
Gather at the border keep and we will plan the next push.
Bad night for {realm}. There will be better ones.
I should have stayed by the healers.
The lord went down and so did my mood.
They outplayed us at the gate. Credit where it is due.
Ram broke before the door did. Not our night.
We lost the field, not our nerve.
Guild, we lost {keep}. Rest up and meet at the portal keep.
Rough one for {guild}. We will get them next time.
That was a beating. Give me a minute to recover.
Nobody blame anyone. We fought as one and lost as one.
Their archers had us pinned the whole time.
They will not hold it long. They never do.
I need a drink and a long sit by the fire.
Retreat! Save who you can!
Help me up, friend. That was a bad one.
Ran out of power at the worst moment. Sorry, everyone.
Held the doorway as long as I could. Not long enough.
Albion will not forget this. Back to Castle Sauvage and regroup.
Back to Svasud Faste. We will rise and strike again.
Back to Druim Ligen, friends. Hibernia will rise again.
Agreed. Regroup and go again.
Their turn tonight. Ours next time.
Hard luck. Rest up.
Not your fault. They had the numbers.
Heading back to regroup now.
On my way to the gathering point.
Chin up, it happens.
Next time we bring more.
Mark my words, they pay for that one.
Ready whenever you are.
That stung. Back soon.
Yes, let us not run in alone.
Lesson learned for next time.
I will be there when we go back.
A loss today, a keep tomorrow.
